technical_observations: The 259KB source is DOM/JQuery-driven: many functions access input elements directly, so it cannot be safely treated as a headless combat module without separating UI and core.
Combat routines access mutable globals _unites, pelotons_attaquant, pelotons_defenseur and id_heros; snapshot these into a pure request context.
Core uses explicit floor/round integer boundaries; preserve exact rounding in golden fixtures.
At least seven stack slots are accessed as indexes 2..8; preserve fixed ordering.
Source header declares GPL; check licensing implications before embedding GPL-derived source into project's distributed server.
Seven synthetic oracles in V5.3 are not an exhaustive Jactari regression suite.
next_delivery: Build a pure JS Jactari-compatible adapter driven by complete input fixtures, with no fallback invented combat result; extract and test phases incrementally.
